knowledgeAnswers.rationale: The no-touch response is mark, withdraw and notify. Opening or pressing the bag is not permitted.
Trained personnel under the site procedure do the search and removal.

practicalCriteria: In an inert mock scene, the learner labels the no-touch boundary, the withdrawal route and the escalation chain. Pass: all three are labelled.
The learner lists the steps for a suspected sharp in order without handling any object. Pass: no-touch, mark, withdraw and notify appear in order.
passRule: 80% on knowledge checks; practical sign-off separate
stopWorkCriteria: A sharp is present or suspected.
A bag or upholstery must be searched by hand to continue.
